parole.significato: synonym of myftar: a mukhtar, particularly (historical) in Albanian contexts.
parole.testo: From Ottoman Turkish مختار (muhtar, “village headman”), from North Levantine Arabic مختار (“village headman”), from substantive application of Arabic مُخْتَار (muḵtār, “chosen”).

parole.significato: A mukhtar, particularly (historical) as a village headman under Ottoman rule and during the Principality of Albania.
parole.testo: From Ottoman Turkish مختار (muhtar, “village headman”), from North Levantine Arabic مختار (“village headman”), from substantive application of Arabic مُخْتَار (muḵtār, “chosen”). Doublet of mukhtar.
